name: Shadow Walk Accuracy
body:
You can end your shadow walk with incredible accuracy.

Prerequisite: Knowledge (planes) 11 ranks, ability to cast shadow walk.

Benefit: When your shadow walk spell ends, you are shunted 1d10 feet in a random direction. Also, you increase your shadow walk speed by 10 miles per hour. This increase stacks with any other increases to your shadow walk speed.

Normal: When your shadow walk spell ends, you are shunted 1d10 x 100 feet in a random direction.
